evals.name: filter-parcel-publication
evals.prompt: Publish ParcelReady to Routing but not InternalScan, and verify consumer input.
assertions: Registers the subscription on the consumer naming the source and allowed type.
Verifies the matching inbox copy and excludes the preceding internal type.

evals.name: locate-downstream-failure
evals.prompt: The contract reached the inbox but a notification never arrived. Where did delivery stop?
assertions: Does not republish a matching inbox copy.
Inspects the consumer observer and downstream receipt.

evals.name: minimize-contract
evals.prompt: Should Orders publish its whole profile event to a subscriber needing only a public label?
assertions: Identifies the public event type the consumer subscribes to.
Excludes internal and unnecessary private fields.
Names source, target, namespace and subscription identity.
